summary: Mariposa County L-601 tower with BC-301 cab, built 1936 in the CCC era; Cal Fire administers it; NHLR-registered 2019; exterior in poor condition; current status unconfirmed.

facts.design: CCC-era L-601 tower with matching BC-301 cab
facts.status_note: Register has no status field. It describes the exterior as in poor condition, with siding damage since a 1991 survey. Firelookout.org's California list marks the site Standing, but that list is not cited in the story. A 2019 assessment is in the brief but its source could not be read.
facts.agency: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection - Madera-Mariposa-Merced Unit (Cal Fire MMU)

access.note: Register says the station is not readily accessible to the public, some 2 miles from paved road; the note is marked 10/91 (October 1991). No public visiting arrangement found.

notes_for_editor: Only two readable sources. The register has no status field, so the story no longer says the tower is standing; firelookout.org's California list (NHLR US 1323, CA 146) marks the site Standing, which an editor could cite with a quoted line if wanted. The brief's 2019 assessment (9 Dec 2019, Buck Rock Foundation support) is not in the story: its source, firelookout.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/cr-ca-sierranv-2019.pdf, returned no text from fetch_text, so it is unverified. Coordinates: register gives 37.731953, -120.261390; the brief's west_us_lookouts record gives -120.2506 longitude (about 1 km east); register used. Registry number: register detail page says US 1327, CA 150; firelookout.org list says US 1323, CA 146; the list may be stale. No staffing history, notable fires or current access arrangement found. One search snippet mentioned a Coulterville bed-and-breakfast named Penon Blanco Lookout; it is not linked to this tower in any source read, so it is left out.
